issues.description: In the template for the Kakuro exercise the attribute number_of_qubits_query_register is initialized to a float (0.0). This is a structural type error: QuantumRegister expects an integer number of qubits. The solution uses an integer (4), and the problem statement describes a 2x2 Kakuro (4 variables). The float in the template will cause immediate runtime/type errors and block students from constructing the QuantumRegister as intended.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template initialization to use an integer number of qubits consistent with the problem and solution (e.g. set number_of_qubits_query_register = 4). Ensure the type is int so QuantumRegister(...) is constructed without type errors.
